Faster storage for the PS Vita (HENkaku/Ensō, firmware 3.60–3.74). A fork of [Vita Turbo Storage](https://github.com/juanjsebgarcia/vita-turbo-storage) by Juan Garcia Alvite.

### Speed (my console, microSD in an SD2Vita, 1 MiB reads)

| Without plugin | GPU-safe reads off | GPU-safe reads on |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 13.5 MiB/s | **19.6 MiB/s** | **18.5 MiB/s** |

### New in 0.3.0

- **Overlapped reads** (Settings > Devices > vita-memio > Advanced): *Off*, *Auto* (tunes itself to your card) or *Fixed*. Experimental, off by default.
- Games that load a lot of graphics data no longer lose speed with the plugin on.
- **GPU-safe reads** now cost only about 1 MiB/s.
- Settings can be changed in safe mode, so an option that caused trouble can be switched off; a start only counts as good after 30 seconds on the home screen.
- The tester shows more of what the plugin is doing.

### Install

1. Copy `vitamemio_kernel.skprx` and `vitamemio.suprx` to `ur0:tai/` (always both).
2. In `ur0:tai/config.txt`, add `ur0:tai/vitamemio_kernel.skprx` under `*KERNEL` and `ur0:tai/vitamemio.suprx` under `*NPXS10015`.
3. Restart, then switch your storage on in **Settings > Devices > vita-memio**.
4. Optional: install `vitamemio_tester.vpk` with VitaShell.

Suggested for playing: your storage on, **GPU-safe reads** on, **Overlapped reads** on *Auto*. Holding **L** at start-up skips all plugins.

`SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums of the files.
